# Rayan Koussa – Full-Stack & Systems Software Engineer Portfolio

> Rayan Koussa is a Full-Stack & Systems Software Engineer holding a Master of Science in Hypermedia & Interactive Technologies from Paris 8 University. Specialized in high-performance web applications, distributed systems, real-time trading engines, Local-First AI architectures, and interactive 3D WebGL experiences.

## Main Pages
- [Home Page](https://rayankoussa.vercel.app/en): Interactive 3D portfolio, biography, technical competencies, and academic background
- [Projects Showcase](https://rayankoussa.vercel.app/en/projects): Production-grade applications, AI agents, algorithmic scalping engines, and web platforms
- [Contact Page](https://rayankoussa.vercel.app/en/contact): Contact form, social links, resume download, and availability

## Featured Engineering Projects
- [Career Finder Helper AI](https://rayankoussa.vercel.app/en/projects): Local-First desktop and extension suite for automated job ingestion across 11 platforms. Features ETL pipeline, vector ATS scoring, resume tailoring, STAR interview simulator, and AES-256 BYOK encryption. (Python, FastAPI, React 19, TypeScript, SQLite, Chrome Extension, BYOK AI)
- [MBTI Explorer](https://rayankoussa.vercel.app/en/projects): Interactive personality-driven location discovery platform built with React, Node.js, Express, and MySQL.
- [KuCoinBot v10](https://rayankoussa.vercel.app/en/projects): High-frequency cryptocurrency scalping engine in Go with real-time orderbook scoring, fractional Kelly sizing, and sub-millisecond execution.
- [Super Arcade 3D Portfolio](https://rayankoussa.vercel.app/en/projects): High-performance cyberpunk interactive portfolio built with Next.js 16, Three.js 3D WebGL Vector Core, and Framer Motion.
- [HTML Semantic Indexing Engine](https://rayankoussa.vercel.app/en/projects): Semantic search engine and crawler with TF-IDF indexing relevance scoring in PHP and MySQL.

## Technical Stack & Core Competencies
- Languages: TypeScript, JavaScript, Python, Go, PHP, Java, SQL, C/C++
- Frontend: Next.js 16, React 19, Three.js, WebGL, Tailwind CSS, Framer Motion, Chrome Extensions
- Backend & Systems: FastAPI, Node.js, Express, Go, REST APIs, WebSockets, Local-First Architecture
- Databases: SQLite, PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB, Redis
- Practices: High-Frequency Trading Systems, Multi-threading, Network Sockets TCP/IP, Web Security, ATS Optimization
